create.name: Chetan Parkyn
create.bio:
Chetan Parkyn is a teacher and author of Human Design, the system that blends astrology, the I Ching, the Kabbalah and the chakras into a chart drawn from the moment of birth. An engineer by training, he worked as a deep-sea diving engineer and a safari leader, travelled in India and spent time around Osho before coming to Human Design in 1993. He has been giving readings for more than three decades, and in 2009 published Human Design: Discover the Person You Were Born to Be, among the first books to open the system to general readers. The Book of Lines, his modern reading of the I Ching, and The Book of Destinies, on the 192 life themes, followed.

He teaches together with his wife and partner Carola Eastwood, an astrologer and counsellor trained in psychosynthesis, under the name Evolutionary Human Design, from a base in Escondido in north San Diego County. Between them they offer personal, relationship and life path readings, a training series and a practitioner certification, as well as a free chart report and a free monthly webinar on the energies of the month. On YouTube Chetan is working through the life themes one at a time, and his newest book, Designed to Thrive, turns the system towards parenting.

books.title: Human Design: Discover the Person You Were Born to Be
books.author: Chetan Parkyn
books.description: An introduction to Human Design for general readers, showing how to draw up and read your own chart from your birth date, time and place. It covers the types, centres and channels and how to use them in work and relationships.

books.title: The Book of Destinies: Discover the Life You Were Born to Live
books.author: Chetan Parkyn
books.description: A guide to the 192 life themes of Human Design, the storyline each person is said to carry through life, set by the position of the sun and earth at birth.

books.title: The Book of Lines: A 21st Century View of the I Ching
books.author: Chetan Parkyn
books.description: A plain-language reading of all 384 lines of the Chinese Book of Changes as they appear in the Human Design chart, which can also be used on its own as an I Ching companion.

books.title: Designed to Thrive: A Human Design Guide for Parents
books.author: Chetan Parkyn
books.description: Parkyn applies Human Design to raising children, helping parents recognise how each child is made and support them without pressing their own expectations on them.

courses.title: Evolutionary Human Design Reading with Chetan
courses.description: A one-to-one session in which Chetan reads your chart with you and explains how your type and design can guide decisions in work and life.

courses.title: Human Design Relationship Reading
courses.description: A joint reading of two charts for couples who have each had a personal reading, looking at where their designs meet and where they tend to misunderstand each other.

courses.title: Evolutionary Life Path Reading with Carola
courses.description: A ninety-minute session with Carola Eastwood that draws on astrology and Human Design to look at the shape of your life so far and the timing of what comes next.

courses.title: Human Design Training Series
courses.description: A staged course in Evolutionary Human Design for people who want to understand the system in depth or use it with clients, and the prerequisite for certification.

courses.title: Human Design Professional Consultation Certification
courses.description: Further training for those who have completed the series and want to give professional Human Design readings, on their own or within an existing practice.

courses.title: Comprehensive Human Design Report
courses.description: A full written report on your chart, generated from your birth details, which they suggest as a next step after the free sample report.

free_resources.title: Free Human Design Report
free_resources.description: Enter your birth date, time and place to receive a free sample report on your Human Design chart by email.

free_resources.title: Complimentary Monthly Webinar
free_resources.description: A free live webinar each month on how the energies of the coming weeks are moving through the Human Design chart and how to time plans around them.
